summary: Pine River (Alvin) Lookout Tower, Forest County: named as a landmark on a 1970 USGS Alvin map (1982 print); a Pastmaps description of a 1972 print of that map says it can be traced there; FFLA lists it as gone. No build, staffing or site record found.

notes_for_editor: The 1970 Alvin map lists the tower as a landmark, and a Pastmaps description of its 1972 print says it can be traced there, so its existence in the early 1970s is better supported than its build date. No source gives a build date, design, height, owner or staffing. The fate evidence is the FFLA 'Tower Gone' line only. Pastmaps pages look like machine-written catalogue copy; only the landmark names are used as evidence. The Forest Lookouts list places the tower in the Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest; no source says who administers the site or whether it is open to the public. FFLA (45.94926, -88.82656) and OSM (45.9494025, -88.8262374) coordinates differ by a few tens of metres. The DNR paragraph is statewide background only. Not checked: the Forest Lookouts list and USGS sheets were not compared against a primary USGS record.
